text_block_list.text:
Sakura Laurel tried to bottle up her 
feelings about the Japanese Derby. She 
even found herself averting her eyes from 
Narita Brian, the one she admired so 
deeply.

The Trainer also worries and talks with 
Biwa Hayahide, indirectly sharing Sakura 
Laurel's feelings about Narita Brian and 
the Japanese Derby.

Biwa Hayahide spoke. "Do not look away. If 
you give up without trying, that regret 
will stay with you forever."

And if she truly wanted to surpass Narita 
Brian, she would need to understand her 
true essence. The Trainer steels their 
resolve.

Then, you present Sakura Laurel with a 
path forward. Whether or not to run in the 
Japanese Derby... A choice must be made 
for your future together.
